[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T11:32:15Z, by staff] Ryder System Reports Q3 2026 Earnings and Raises Full-Year Guidance
Ryder System, Inc. reported an increase in third-quarter comparable earnings and revenue, leading the company to raise its 2026 comparable earnings guidance.
Ryder System, Inc. announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, highlighting growth in both comparable earnings and revenue. Following these results, the company increased its full-year 2026 comparable earnings guidance. The reported adjusted earnings per share of $4.33 exceeded the FactSet consensus estimate of $4.15. Additionally, the company's updated non-GAAP earnings per share guidance range of $14.85 to $15.05 is above the previously expected FactSet estimate of $14.67.
